name: Afroasiatic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a language). Afroasiatic (Afro-Asiatic) is the phylum comprising Berber, Semitic, Egyptian, Cushitic, Omotic and Chadic. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics have a top-level node for its member families (Berber, Semitic/Arabic and others). Glottolog top node afro1255. It carries no grapheme table: a family node has no orthography of its own, and the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table belongs to a member language spec with a cited orthography.

sources.author: Frajzyngier, Z. & Shay, E. (eds.)
sources.title: The Afroasiatic Languages
sources.notes: Reference for the Afroasiatic phylum and its internal branching (structural ancestry node only).

location.notes: Glottolog's computed centroid for the Afro-Asiatic family — a summary of a whole clade's range, not a place anyone speaks.
